svg.title: Results
svg.desc: Representative SlicerDSpace outputs: anatomical priors (a), microstructure maps (b), segmentation, parcellation and cortical-surface sub-blocks, with four surface views in one horizontal line; thickness and parcellation use the subject-native pial surface), tractograms including SAF (c), WMQL with optional regional cerebellar selections, TractCloud and WMA (d), and connectome (e), in four category rows. Every still is cropped to its content (background only). Sources and review status are recorded with the figure inputs; not a controlled cross-method comparison.
